upper_row_ss: The Firm's London office (25 Finsbury Square, London EC2A 1DU) represented Compass Maritime Bank Société Anonyme in a syndicated lending transaction, assigned matter number C&H-2019-BF-02114 (the "Compass Syndicated Lending Matter"). The engagement involved the structuring and documentation of a multi-tranche syndicated credit facility for an unrelated borrower in the
lower_row_ss: offshore energy sector. That matter was completed and formally closed in the Firm's records on March 12, 2020. No current engagement with Compass Maritime Bank SA exists, and no post-closing advisory or other work has been performed since the matter's closure. Importantly, the proposed representation of TSL is not adverse to Compass Maritime Bank SA. To the contrary, Compass Maritime Bank SA serves as TSL's primary revolving credit facility lender under a €75,000,000 senior secured revolving credit facility agreement dated September 1, 2020. TSL's notification to Compass Maritime Bank under the facility's material litigation disclosure clause (applicable threshold: claims or exposures exceeding €2,000,000) is anticipated as a routine compliance step in the current engagement — this notification does not constitute, and is not reasonably expected to give rise to, any adverse action, claim, or dispute between TSL and the bank. No confidential information received from Compass Maritime Bank SA in connection with the prior closed matter (C&H-2019-BF-02114) is relevant to, or could reasonably be used in connection with, the proposed TSL engagement.

upper_row_ss: Hit 2: Hailong Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.

The Firm's New York office (400 Lexington Avenue, New York, NY 10170) was approached by Hailong Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. in or about March 2021 for a preliminary assessment regarding the potential applicability of review by the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) to a proposed acquisition by Hailong of a U.S.-based marine equipment component manufacturer. The preliminary assessment was assigned tracking number C&H-2021-RA-03502 for administrative purposes. Following an initial evaluation and a single introductory telephone conference, the Firm declined the engagement,
lower_row_ss: and no formal engagement letter was executed. The matter was marked as "Declined — No Engagement" in the Firm's records on April 2, 2021. No confidential information was received from Hailong Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. in connection with the preliminary assessment; the sole communication consisted of publicly available information regarding the proposed acquisition target and a general inquiry regarding CFIUS jurisdictional thresholds. No attorney-client relationship was formed with Hailong Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.
